payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CMIP6 climate models show accuracy in simulating precipitation processes based on the agreement between observed data and model predictions, particularly regarding forced changes in mean and extreme precipitation.

claims.text: The relationship between relative spatial precipitation patterns and the forced precipitation trend derived from climate model simulations suggests accuracy of the CMIP6 climate models in simulating relevant processes.
The degree to which model simulations accurately represent responses to forcing and simulate changes in precipitation remains debated, indicating variability in model accuracy.
